note: Nebraska NF, Pine Ridge District, 8 mi south of Chadron on the west side of US-385 (1 mi south of Chadron State Park), in ponderosa pine. Gravel pads, mostly short back-ins; a 2025 reviewer says only 2 sites take a 40-ft rig, with a tight turnaround at the end. Picnic tables, pedestal grills, fire rings. Pine Ridge Trail via the Outrider and Strong Canyon trailheads. Heavy US-385 truck noise. --Claude
summary: Booking corrected: recreation.gov lists Red Cloud only as a first-come Scan & Pay site, not reservable (reservable true / recreation.gov -> false / none, fcfs always). $10 a night confirmed on the FS page and rec.gov rate table; FS says open year-round, 13 sites, vault toilet, no potable water (added), 14-day limit. Note cleaned. Not waterfront stays.
flags: BOOKING CHANGE: the entry says reservable on recreation.gov, but recreation.gov's only rate season is 'First-come, First-served Season' (WalkInScanPay $10), and the RIDB catalog has no reservable campsite. The FS page says 'Please pay onsite'. The recreation.gov link in `website` is the Scan & Pay page, not a booking page; worth keeping only as the payment link.

Fee conflict on recreation.gov: its fee description still says '$15/night/vehicle. $7.50/extra vehicle', but its rate table charges $10 and the FS page (updated March 2025) says $10 + $5 extra vehicle. Went with $10.
Fit: no length posted. RV Life 7/2025 (motorhome, paid $10): 'Nice RV sites only 2 will handle a 40' tight turnaround at the end'; 2012: 'Not big rig friendly'. A 23-ft motorhome should fit; kept.
Pin OK: stored 42.69455,-103.00282 sits at the entrance off US-385; the FS/rec.gov point 42.69583,-103.00361 is ~155 m NW along the campground road.
